## Copied folders
- `vendor/fenny/` — Feynman-voice-app at `fc32865ed16f` (docs, api, scene, teach, ui, voice: the Phonon Expo module and the Kitten TTS package). Owner’s code.
- `vendor/atria/` — Atria at `8fedbbdfb6a2`: 18 Swift files + `docs/METRIC_VALIDATION_PLAN.md` + `LICENSE` (MIT) and `LICENSE-APACHE`.
- `vendor/calai/` — Cal-AI at `76f306269406`: nutrition model, prompt, card, chart, screen, `LICENSE` (MIT).

**Vendor folders are reference only.** Nothing in `apps/` imports from `vendor/`. Ported code goes into `packages/core` or `apps/mobile/src`, with a header naming the source file and commit, and an entry in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

## To update a pin
Change the commit here, re-copy the files, and note what changed in the commit message. Never update a pin in the middle of a phase.
